business_scope.primary_industry_name: Tailoring of Licensed Theatrical Costume Robes and Synthetic Wigs

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Spain (Kingdom of Spain, Reino de España)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental Roman-Germanic); unitary national legal system; EU supranational law directly applicable in AML/CFT and digital-market fields; note: the Basque Country and Navarre enjoy special statutory fiscal autonomy, although the default common tax regime applies to entities registered in Madrid.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Spain-Mexico BIT (Acuerdo para la Promoción y Protección Recíproca de Inversiones, signed 1995, amended 2006, in force)
DTAAs with ~95+ jurisdictions including Mexico (1992), China (1990), USA (1990), and all EU Member States
EU-Japan EPA and EU-Mercosur Agreement (provisional application context) relevant to Latin America bridge strategy

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo (arts. 2-4, 14); Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo (Reglamento); Real Decreto-Ley 7/2021, de 27 de abril (transposition of Directive (EU) 2019/1151 on digital incorporation and UBO registers); Orden JUS/319/2018 (UBO data model); Ley 19/2003, art. 7 bis-7 ter (foreign direct investment authorization for non-EU investors); Regulation (EU) 2019/452 (FDI screening); Ley 6/2023 (Mercados de Valores, AML reinforcement); SEPBLAC Circular 1/2022.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - Spain operates a central UBO register (Registro Central de Titularidades Reales) under the Colegio de Registradores and SEPBLAC/FIU. The register is not fully public: access is limited to SEPBLAC, AEAT, law enforcement, judicial authorities, and obliged entities performing customer due diligence. This restricted-access design reflects Spanish data protection law (LOPDGDD 3/2018) and partially derogates from the public-access model of Directive (EU) 2018/843.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder) granted by each future shareholder and each appointed director to the incorporation attorney-in-fact for subscribing the formation deed before a Spanish notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the grantor's country of residence, or a Spanish Notary if the grantor executes in Spain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille Convention (apostille by the competent authority of the issuing State), followed by sworn translation (traducción jurada) into Spanish

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / corporate registry extract (Certificado de Vigencia) for any corporate shareholder established outside Spain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial registry or competent corporate registrar of the shareholder's home country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; for non-apostille States, consular legalization before the Consulate of Spain in the issuing State, followed by sworn translation into Spanish

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Disclosure and PEP Declaration (Declaración de Titularidad Real y de Condición de PEP) signed by all ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Spanish Notary within the incorporation process; if executed abroad, a foreign notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if executed abroad) plus sworn translation; when executed in Spain, the declaration is integrated directly into the public deed

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies (compulsas) of passports or national identity cards of all directors, appointees, and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of issuance of the identification document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus sworn translation into Spanish; alternative: certification by a Spanish notary upon physical or trusted digital identification

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every shareholder, director, and UBO at onboarding and annually thereafter against: (1) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (2) UN Security Council sanctions; (3) OFAC SDN List (EU/global operations via Stripe and Shopify in USD); (4) national Spanish sanctions list coordinated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and SEPBLAC; (5) adverse-media checks for Latin American political-exposure links. PEP identification triggers Enhanced Due Diligence under art. 14.2 of Ley 10/2010, senior-management approval, and source-of-funds verification. Because ISIC 3240 is classified Low_Risk_Standard, standard CDD applies, yet cross-border LatAm payments and Stripe/Shopify aggregator onboarding will require the corporate wallet to evidence UBO-registered status and negative screening results.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Sede Electrónica del Registro Mercantil Central (RMC), Madrid - www.rmc.es; also accessible through the Colegio de Registradores portals and the CIRCE/PAE entrepreneurship network (Documento Único Electrónico).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be written in Spanish or in any co-official language (Catalan, Galician, Basque) using Latin script and Spanish orthographic conventions. Non-Latin scripts are transliterated and must follow RAE norms; foreign abbreviations are accepted only where the corporate purpose demonstrably requires them. Accents and diacritics must conform to official Spanish spelling; the transliteration of a foreign founding name must match the shareholder's identity documents exactly.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Identical or confusingly similar names already indexed by the Registro Mercantil Central
Official and institutional terms: 'España', 'Gobierno', 'Ministerio', 'Ayuntamiento', 'Banco de España', 'Tribunal', 'Instituto Nacional'
Acronyms of public bodies and international organizations: 'ONU', 'UE', 'OTAN', 'AEMPS', 'SEPBLAC', 'CNMV', 'UNESCO'
Sector terms requiring prior ministerial authorization: 'Banco', 'Seguro', 'Seguros', 'Caja', 'Mutua', 'Financiera', 'Emisora', 'Sociedad Anónima', 'Fondos'
Terms implying a different legal vehicle (e.g., inclusion of 'S.A.', 'S.L.', 'S.C.' within the name to defeat identity checks)
Scandalous, offensive, or contra-legal custom terms (art. 407 Reglamento del Registro Mercantil)
Names of living or widely known deceased persons without express consent, and registered trademarks not owned by the applicant
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The negative-name certificate (Certificación Negativa de Denominación) is valid for 90 days and may be extended once for an additional 90 days by application to the RMC before expiry (arts. 413.1-413.2, Real Decreto 1784/1996). If the RMC rejects the requested denomination, the applicant may file a reconsideration appeal (recurso de alzada) before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (DGSJFP) within one month of notification, attaching the RMC's denial; alternatively, the applicant may immediately submit a new name request. The public incorporation deed must be executed within the validity window, failing which the certificate lapses without priority rights and a fresh application is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a standalone solution under art. 9 of the Ley de Sociedades de Capital (Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010): the registered office must coincide with the place of effective administration or principal establishment within Spain. A coworking-space address supported by an executed lease, nameplate, dedicated access, and administrative presence is admissible and customary for low-risk manufacturing/trading companies; a mere mailbox or mail-forwarding virtual address fails the substance test and exposes the company to AEAT relocation of the registered office, retroactive tax-residence assessment, and refusal of the commercial registry to inscribe the deed.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low_Standard_Risk: approximately 5% annual probability of an unannounced AEAT or Registro Mercantil verification for a compliant ISIC 3240 manufacturing/retail entity. The probability rises to 15-20% if foreign UBO ownership exceeds 75%, if the registered office is a shared coworking address without visible signage, or if USD/EUR cross-border flows via Stripe and Shopify trigger AEAT fiscal-residence review under art. 8 LSC and territoriality rules of the Spanish Income Tax Act.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Negative name certificate (Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social) application via RMC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory RMC tariff for denomination certification (approx. EUR 10.50 - 15.00)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the public incorporation deed (escritura de constitución) including Bylaws for a EUR 3,000 capital Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated notary tariff (Arancel Notarial) - approx. EUR 190-220 including bookkeeping and notarial copy

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial legal counsel - abogado colegiado for pre-incorporation due diligence, Bylaws drafting, POA coordination, and cross-border shareholder structuring
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External law firm specialising in Spanish corporate and international tax
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border SME incorporations: EUR 700-1,300 one-off depending on LatAm documentation complexity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translation (traducción jurada) of three foreign apostilled documents into Spanish
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator accredited by the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the EU
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate in Spain: approx. EUR 45-60 per document based on page volume

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille requests for three documents in the shareholders' and directors' home countries
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent Apostille authority of each issuing State
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: International statutory tariffs: approx. EUR 20-30 per apostille, varying by issuing State

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registry filing and BORME publication
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Mercantil de Madrid and Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil (BORME)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory exemption for electronic incorporation via CIRCE/DUE for SMEs; BORME publication tariff approx. EUR 12.50

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO notification - declaration of ultimate beneficial owners before notary and registration in the Registro Central de Titularidades Reales
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish Notary and Colegio de Registradores
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff plus registry management fee: approx. EUR 70-80

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office substance setup - six-month coworking lease sub-agreement with signage, dedicated access, and administrative mailbox in a Madrid satellite business center
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Municipal market benchmark: EUR 150-250 per month per substantive desk with meeting-room access; six-month prepayment

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and EU sanctions screening package for foreign UBOs and directors via SEPBLAC-approved database, plus AEAT form preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML/CFT risk desk of the appointed law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for low-risk standard screening bundle covering three persons and two corporate entities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Provisional tax identification number (NIF provisional) application for the company in formation and NIE file preparation for non-resident managers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and Dirección General de la Policía (NIE only where physical appearance required)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Exempt / free of charge under Spanish administrative tariffs; NIE administrative stamp approx. EUR 6.50 when applicable post-incorporation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), arts. 20-33 (constitución e inscripción), art. 62 (capital social mínimo de la SL), arts. 209-233 (administración social), together with the Reglamento del Registro Mercantil and applicable municipal licensing laws.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (name reservation) and Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered office (final corporate inscription); notarial execution is performed before a Spanish Notary Public.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura de Constitución (public incorporation deed) submitted for inscription in the corresponding Registro Mercantil. Spain does not charge a separate central filing fee; notarial and registry tariffs are regulated separately.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The minimum share capital for an SL is EUR 3,000, which must be fully subscribed and paid in cash before notarial execution. A bank certificate evidencing the deposit of the contribution in a Spanish credit institution must be delivered to the notary, and administrators may not dispose of the deposited funds until the company is inscribed in the Registro Mercantil. No separate statutory escrow account is required beyond this bank deposit requirement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Escritura de Constitución of the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada executed on ______ before the Notary is ratified. The subscriptions and cash payments for the share capital are approved; the administration accepts its appointments. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office is established at ______, Spain, and that the administrators are instructed to give notice thereof to the Registro Mercantil. The Board appoints ______ as sole administrator or joint administrators, with the powers granted by law and by the Articles, and authorizes them to obtain the tax identification number, pay formation expenses, complete all filings, open bank accounts, and effect final registration of the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reservation of Company Name before the Central Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Mercantile Registry), Madrid - online application
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for a negative name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación social) through the electronic system of the Registro Mercantil Central, listing up to five alternative corporate names in order of priority. Provide the intended corporate type (SL) and the corporate purpose. The certificate is valid for three months and must be delivered to the notary at the time the incorporation deed is executed.
required_dossiers: Identity documents and Spanish NIE for all founding partners
Power of attorney if a legal representative is appointed
Application form for the negative name certificate
Confirmation of the proposed corporate name and the SL entity type
Statement of the intended corporate object in Spanish
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for conflict or resemblance with an existing name, the applicant may file a new application with additional alternative names or appeal the refusal before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within the statutory period; priority is determined by filing date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarial Drawing and Execution of the Public Incorporation Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notario) in the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the draft articles of association (estatutos) and the incorporation deed (escritura de constitución). Open a temporary corporate bank account or obtain a bank capital-deposit certificate for at least EUR 3,000. All founding partners must execute the deed personally or by legal representative before the notary, who verifies identity, capacity, the capital certificate, and the lawfulness of the bylaws. The notary issues an authorized first copy and, as applicable, transmits the deed electronically to the Registro Mercantil.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate (certificado de denominación social)
Bank certificate evidencing the deposit of the EUR 3,000 share capital
Draft articles of association signed by the founders
Valid passports or Spanish NIE for each founder
Consent forms and identification documents for the proposed administrators
Exact registered-office address in Spain
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The notary will state any legal or formal defects in the draft deed; the defects are cured by amending the bylaws or deed and re-executing before the same or another notary. If authorization is refused, a rescheduled execution with corrected documentation resolves the query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment or Exemption Declaration of Indirect Taxes on Corporate Formation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) - Provincial Tax Management Office or electronic headquarters
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty business days after the notarial execution, file Modelo 600 to settle or expressly claim the applicable exemption from the Impuesto sobre Transmisiones Patrimoniales y Actos Jurídicos Documentados (ITP-AJD) corporate-operations modality. Under the EU capital-duty framework, the formation of an SL is generally exempt from effective capital duty in Spain. Legal counsel should confirm the specific treatment in the relevant autonomía.
required_dossiers: Modelo 600 (self-assessment form)
First or authorized copy of the public incorporation deed
Negative name certificate and NIE numbers of the founders
Bank capital certificate or notarial deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office questions the filing, submit a rectification application (solicitud de rectificación) with supporting deed documents; a late or incomplete Modelo 600 may be cured by filing an amended self-assessment with the corresponding surcharge and interest before AEAT.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for the Provisional Tax Identification Number (NIF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) - Tax Identification Number section or online with electronic certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the deed is executed, submit Form 036 (census declaration) to the AEAT to obtain the provisional NIF of the company. State the SL entity type, the registered-office address, the corporate purpose, and the administrators' details. Once inscription in the Registro Mercantil is completed, the provisional NIF is converted into the definitive NIF.
required_dossiers: Form 036 census declaration
Authorized copy of the public incorporation deed
DNI/NIE of all directors/administrators
Identity document of the legal representative filing the application
Proof of the registered-office address, if separately requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT returns an error or requests additional information, the filing may be corrected and resubmitted electronically; documentary deficiencies are cured through the AEAT supplementary-document channel within the statutory response period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Mercantile Registry and Acquisition of Legal Personality
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary submits the incorporation deed for inscription through the coordinated notary-registry electronic filing process. The registrar verifies the statutory clauses and the legality of the capital contributions and issues the registration. Upon inscription, the company acquires legal personality, and the directors may open definitive bank accounts, register the company with social security, and execute contracts in the corporate name.
required_dossiers: First and second copy of the public deed, as applicable
Modelo 600 proof, where not already exempt
Provisional NIF application record
Consent instruments of the directors and any appointed corporate officers
Bank capital-deposit certificate retained in the notary file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any suspension or refusal by the registrar is cured by correcting the defect and resubmitting the deed or supplemental documents; the affected party may file a recurso gubernativo before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within one month, followed by judicial review in the civil courts.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Licensing Department (Concejalía de Actividades/Urbanismo) of the respective Ayuntamiento and the regional environmental authority of the corresponding Comunidad Autónoma.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Apertura y Funcionamiento / Comunicación Ambiental Previa (Municipal Operating and Activity License for a low-impact manufacturing and retail facility)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico; where environmental competence is regional, the environmental authority of the Spanish Comunidad Autónoma (Consejería de Medio Ambiente).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not subject to a full Environmental Impact Assessment; classified as a low-impact or 'inocua' activity requiring municipal environmental communication (comunicación ambiental) or a simplified environmental authorization (licencia ambiental simplificada) when dyeing, coating, or solvent-use operations are installed above the applicable thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater must comply with Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2001 (Ley de Aguas), municipal sewer ordinances, and typical industrial-pretreatment limits (e.g. pH 6-9, COD below 750 mg/L and suspended solids below 500 mg/L); VOC emissions from adhesives, paints, dyes and cleaning solvents must comply with the solvent-using installation thresholds of Real Decreto 117/2003; hazardous textile waste and packaging must be handled by an authorized waste manager under Ley 7/2022 de residuos y suelos contaminados.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by a competent registered technician or industrial engineer, covering evacuation routes, extinguishers, emergency lighting, and structural fire-resistance; municipal opening-license inspection verifies emergency-exit loading and structural load capacity; mandatory workplace risk assessment and occupational health planning under Ley 31/1995 and Real Decreto 486/1997 must be completed before employees begin work.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), official portal https://www.agenciatributaria.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Spanish SL obtains NIF (CIF) automatically upon registration with the Registro Mercantil. Non-resident owners must ensure the SL registers for tax purposes; foreign entities require NIF application via AEAT submission of incorporation documents and tax identification forms.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available. Tax classification follows legal form; hybrid mismatch rules apply under EU ATAD for cross-border structures.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 50,000 EUR annual turnover threshold for mandatory registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturae e-invoicing for B2B transactions since 2023; real-time fiscal clearance via AEAT API with digital invoicing stamps and reporting obligations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to goods exported outside the EU and qualifying services provided to non-EU recipients. Requires proof of export and non-EU destination.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT audits may result in fines up to 100% of evaded tax and criminal sanctions for fraudulent claims; retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT amounts.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) and European Central Bank (ECB)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates under a fully convertible Euro currency regime. Capital account transactions face no restrictions or prior approvals. Current account transactions, including profit remittances to non-resident shareholders, are unrestricted with zero surrender or approval requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion of export proceeds is required under Spanish or EU law. Receipts may be retained in foreign currency accounts or freely converted to EUR without statutory timelines or fixed ratios, subject solely to general AML/CFT reporting obligations.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for licensed digital EMIs via providers such as Stripe and Shopify Payments under Spanish and EU frameworks (PSD2 and MiCA). Offshore digital EMIs are permitted with full KYC/AML compliance and local licensing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for KYC interviews with directors and authorized signatories for Spanish SL entities. Remote opening is not permitted without notarized power of attorney or proxies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed beneficial ownership or unexplained source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized articles of association, beneficial ownership register extracts, tax residency proofs, incorporation certificates, and source of wealth documentation

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital via SWIFT MT103 wires using purpose codes 'CAP' or 'EQTY'. Verification requires shareholder resolutions, incorporation documents, and beneficial ownership declarations. All transactions must satisfy Spanish AML reporting thresholds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements cleared via SWIFT MT103 for payments and Commercial Letters of Credit for structured trade finance. Correspondent banking arrangements in EUR or USD with full documentation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Annual Accounts with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 4 months after the end of the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 3,000 EUR and potential administrative sanctions or company strike-off for non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 25 days after the end of the fourth month following the fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines, late payment surcharges, and possible criminal liability for persistent non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Modelo 347 Annual Filing (Information on Third-Party Operations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 January following the end of the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of 60-600 EUR per omission or incorrect declaration

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Net turnover > 10 million EUR, total assets > 10 million EUR, or average number of employees > 50
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad - PGC)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual confirmation required; update beneficial ownership details in the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales upon changes in shareholding or control

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 100-600 USD (for administrative agent or gestor services)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 2,000-6,000 USD (if mandatory audit triggered by size thresholds)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% for newly created entities in the first two years of profitable activity (subject to conditions); R&D and innovation tax credits up to 42% of qualifying expenses; deductions for export activities and reinvestment of extraordinary income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 200 (Impuesto de Sociedades) – filed electronically via the AEAT Sede Electrónica (www.agenciatributaria.es)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 days following the six-month period after the fiscal year-end (e.g., for a December 31 year-end, due by July 25 of the following year).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net turnover (Importe neto de la cifra de negocios)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide turnover if the entity is tax resident in Spain; for non-resident entities with a permanent establishment, report only Spanish-source turnover.
Calculate based on Spanish-source income and deductible expenses; apply transfer pricing adjustments if applicable.
Use 25% general rate; 15% for new entities if eligible; 19% for non-resident entities without a permanent establishment (subject to treaty override).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits and deductions (Deducciones y bonificaciones)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only credits available under domestic law or applicable DTA; non-residents without PE cannot claim most domestic incentives.
Sum of tax after credits; ensure withholding taxes on outbound payments are correctly reported.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: 5% of the tax amount if filed within 3 months of deadline; 10% within 6 months; 15% within 12 months; 20% after 12 months, plus late payment interest (currently 3.75% per annum). Additional surcharge of 1% per month for each month of delay after the initial 12-month period.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 202 (Pago fraccionado) – quarterly advance payment for companies with net turnover > €6 million; Form 222 for smaller companies – filed via AEAT Sede Electrónica
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within the first 20 days of April, July, October, and January (for the preceding quarter).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income for the period (Base del pago fraccionado)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-residents with a PE, compute based on Spanish-source income; for others, not applicable.
Standard 18% for large companies (turnover > €6M); 20% for others; may be reduced for certain entities.
Calculate as Box 1 × Box 2, minus any tax credits and prior payments.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: 5% of the amount due, increasing to 10% after 3 months, 15% after 6 months, 20% after 12 months, plus late payment interest. Failure to file may also trigger a flat penalty of €200 per form.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim reduced withholding under a Double Tax Agreement (DTA), the beneficial owner must submit Form 210 (non-resident income tax return) and provide a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the home country tax authority. For EU/EEA residents, the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive may eliminate withholding tax if the parent holds at least 5% of the Spanish subsidiary's capital for at least 12 months. The TRC must be submitted to the Spanish paying agent before the payment date; retroactive relief is possible via refund application within 4 years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory rate 24% (reduced to 10% under many DTAs, e.g., US, UK, Germany). Interest: statutory rate 19% (reduced to 10% under many DTAs; 0% under EU Interest-Royalty Directive if conditions met).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required if net turnover exceeds EUR 10,000,000; Master File required if the group's consolidated turnover exceeds EUR 45,000,000. Country-by-Country Report required for groups with consolidated revenue ≥ EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain does not have a specific Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) like the UAE, but applies general anti-abuse rules (GAAR) and substance-over-form principles. For treaty benefits, the entity must demonstrate real economic activity (e.g., premises, employees, decision-making) in Spain. The Spanish Tax Agency may challenge transactions lacking commercial rationale or substance, especially in low-tax jurisdictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of income, overstatement of deductions, or use of fictitious invoices to reduce corporate tax liability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 50% to 150% of the tax evaded, plus late payment interest. Criminal prosecution for amounts exceeding €120,000 per year may result in imprisonment from 2 to 6 years and fines up to six times the evaded amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held jointly and severally liable for the tax debt if they participated in or knowingly allowed the evasion. Civil restitution, travel bans, and disqualification from holding corporate office for up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a mere conduit with no real business activity, no employees, no physical premises, or no commercial rationale, particularly to obtain treaty benefits or avoid Spanish tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty benefits, recharacterization of transactions, and imposition of a 25% penalty on the underpaid tax. The company may be deemed a tax haven and subject to anti-abuse measures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for the tax deficiency if they signed false declarations or failed to ensure substance. Travel bans and potential criminal charges for fraud if intent is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement anti-money laundering controls, accepting cash payments above €10,000 without reporting, or engaging in transactions with sanctioned entities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €150,000 for serious infractions, and up to €1,500,000 for very serious infractions. Criminal liability for money laundering can lead to imprisonment from 6 months to 6 years and fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held criminally liable if they knowingly participate in or fail to prevent money laundering. Personal asset seizure, travel bans, and imprisonment up to 6 years.
